items.title: Claude Code 2.1.323 released
items.text: Added Code Mode, an experimental opt-in in which Claude writes JavaScript to call its tools; see to turn it on, or to turn it off for an organization · Added engines["claude-code"] to plugin.json: plugins outside their stated Claude Code version range are not installed, updated or loaded, and install and update pick the newest version that fits · Added type checking of a plugin's TypeScript hooks module to claude plugin validate; each finding is a warning, and --strict fails on it · Added to claude plugin validate the $ nouns a mod's engine.create hook adds, withholds or replaces
